answer: Verify the enclave before the identity earns. The agent signs its first receipt inside a hardware TEE, the node matches the quote to a vendor root, then opens a stream that releases copper rewards across forty epochs. Pull the key and the stream stops. One enclave cannot front a hundred hollow clones, because the quote is tied to a single operator the way a juniper is tied to one plot. Renting that hardware and surviving the audit costs more than the farm mints.
